description: The scores of the person's linked Cesure account ("My scores"), the most recently changed at the top, 200 a call (offset skips that many; when there are more, the answer's more gives the next offset): id, title, when last changed, and its tags; then every tag of the account, with how many scores carry it. Needs the account linked.

offset.description: How many scores to skip, most recent first (default 0): the answer's more gives the next.

name: list_my_scores
title: List my scores
